_about: The words that carry clinical meaning in a PriMock57 consultation. Two uses from one artifact: the measurement set for content-term recall (does the meaning survive transcription, as opposed to the function words), and the contextual biasing lexicon to feed faster-whisper's `hotwords` or an initial_prompt.
_why: WER counts every token equally, so a model that drops 200 'yeah's and keeps every drug name scores the same as one that does the reverse. On large-v3 mixed, twenty function-word and backchannel types carry 563 of 1136 combined substitution-plus-deletion errors, 49.6% of the error mass. Whether 13.9% WER is survivable depends entirely on which half the errors land in, and that is what this set measures.
_sources: Diagnosis terms are the canonical labels from primock57_structured.json. Drugs and investigations were read out of the 57 clinician notes. Keep single tokens where possible: term_recall works on normalised tokens, so multi-word terms are listed by their distinctive head word.
